title: Lovie Austin's compositions and "Bleeding Hearted Blues"
summary: Albertson saw an older man holding Lovie's music; Hunter holds letters from Lovie giving her control of the songs.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song

blocks.x: What was the name of that -- the gentleman who lived with Lovie -- older man.
He showed me -- he had all the music, all the papers for all of Lovie's compositions. these corporations.
I wonder why he didn't give them to you.
I was so afraid that he wouldn't --
He doesn't -- he didn't know what to do with them. He didn't, I bet you.
And I kept telling him how important it was to renew --
Did he let you have them?

one, if you can get it you should sure try to get it. I recorded it for Lovie. You try to get it. "Bleeding Hearted Blues," in fact I've got most of the names of them. And Lovie"and I got a letter saying, whatever you do with these songs -- I want you to do whatever you want to do with them. And it's all right with me. I got those letters. That was before she died, so they can't say they were written after she died.
All right. I want you to have them, because maybe you can do something with them.
The main thing is to keep them from falling ... (unintelligible).
I'm going to keep them. They'll not get -- nobody's hands. I'm keeping them in my vault.
